svg.aria-label: A boot flow: one command starts the stack, then a chain of checks, each one a real question. Does Postgres accept a connection and answer a query? Does Redis answer PING? Does Sentinel name the right master? Did a worker pick up a test job from the queue? Each check either passes to the next or stops the boot with the exact reason. At the end: ready to cook.
svg.text: A BOOT SCRIPT THAT PROVES IT
"container is running" is not the same as "it works"
STOP: still replaying, or wrong password
STOP: points at a master that's gone
a worker picked up a test job?
STOP: running, but on the wrong broker
every check asks what a real
request would ask, and fails loudly
